questions.question: Which source is controlling for a proposition in a stated jurisdiction and date?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
ASK {
  ?work a okflaw:LegislationWork ; okflaw:authorityClass ?authority ; eli:jurisdiction ?jurisdiction .
  ?expression a eli:LegalExpression ; eli:is_realization_of ?work ; okflaw:validFrom ?date .
  ?proposition a okflaw:SynthesisedProposition ; okflaw:supportedBy ?passage .
}

questions.question: Which official effect changed a selected work or provision and has it been applied?
What denominator supports a claim of source-family coverage?
Can an agent distinguish source evidence from a synthesised proposition?
Can a user tell whether an access route is public, restricted, stale or unavailable?
Can a user traverse a legal work through its expression to a source-identified manifestation and media format?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
ASK {
  ?work a okflaw:LegislationWork .
  ?expression a eli:LegalExpression ; eli:is_realization_of ?work .
  ?manifestation a okflaw:LegalManifestation ; eli:embodies ?expression ; dcterms:format ?format .
}

questions.question: Can a source-native provision be distinguished from a hash-bound evidential passage?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX oa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/oa#>
ASK {
  ?provision a okflaw:Provision ; dcterms:isPartOf ?work ; okflaw:sourceRecord ?record .
  ?passage a okflaw:LegalPassage ; oa:hasSource ?source ; okflaw:sourceHash ?hash .
}

questions.question: Can a case be connected to its court, governed source record and jurisdiction without inventing a cross-source identity?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
ASK {
  ?case a okflaw:Case ; okflaw:decidingCourt ?court ; okflaw:sourceRecord ?record ; eli:jurisdiction ?jurisdiction .
  ?court a okflaw:Court .
  ?record a okflaw:SourceRecord .
  ?jurisdiction a okflaw:Jurisdiction .
}

questions.question: Can a publication identify its responsible organisation and authoritative catalogue route?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
ASK {
  ?publication a okflaw:Publication ; dcterms:publisher ?organisation ; okflaw:sourceRecord ?record .
  ?organisation a okflaw:Organisation .
  ?record a okflaw:SourceRecord ; dcat:landingPage ?route .
}

questions.question: Can a temporal state be traced to its observation boundary and authoritative source?
questions.ask:
PREFIX okflaw: <https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-uk-legislation/profile/whole-law/v1#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>
ASK {
  ?work okflaw:temporalState ?state .
  ?state a okflaw:TemporalState ; okflaw:stateType ?type ; time:hasBeginning ?instant ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?source ; okflaw:sourceRecord ?record .
  ?instant a time:Instant .
}
